name: Ignis
source:
A man mysterious even for an inhabitant of the island. He shows little emotion, and hardly ever speaks; no one can tell what truly is going on inside his mind. An artisan dollmaker. 

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/enigma/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
